description: Create a specification (status draft | prepared | processing | completed; content inline). `blockedBy` lists specs that must be completed first; the spec and its blockers are created atomically. Adding is all-or-nothing. A blocker that is missing, in another project, the spec itself, already completed, or an ancestor or descendant is rejected with 400; a link that already exists or would create a cycle with 409, so remove wrong links before adding new ones. Children inherit their ancestors' blockers. `todoCardId` creates the spec from a ToDo card, linking the two in the same request.

todoCardId.description: Id of the ToDo card the specification is created from (CLI: --todo-card). The backend records the new specification as the card's resulting specification in the same request. A missing card or a card of another project is rejected with 400; a card that already has a resulting specification is a conflict (409, code `todo_card_already_linked`) and is never overwritten. The call fails with code `TODO_CARD_LINK_NOT_RECORDED`, returning the created specification, if the link turns out not to be recorded.

name: specs_create
title: Create specification
